# Repository-wide instructions for coding agents

This repository is the independent `Remotion-gpt-chat` project. Never read, import, copy or modify `YunRah2103/yunus-video-lab` or any YUNEX materials.

Read `AGENTS.md`, `production/AGENTS.md` and `production/PIPELINE.md` before production edits. Work on scoped branches, use reliable engineering sources and be explicit about film approval versus automation. Follow `.github/skills/` for specialized tasks and use `production/tools/handoff.py` for verifiable artifact handoffs. Do not add paid AI services or deploy agents automatically. Keep existing Remotion compositions and assets intact.

Always test TypeScript and Python, inspect true native renders and only issue release claims with a successful GitHub workflow run ID and exact binary artifact.
